plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for FireBrick router/firewall appliance. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for FB2xxx/FB6xxx/FB9xxx series (enterprise PEN 24693).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilisation of the FireBrick appliance (fbCpuAll, instantaneous value of CPU core 1). The device reports hundredths of a percent; the collector divides by 100 to a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total RAM of the FireBrick appliance in bytes (fbTotalMem, reported in KiB and multiplied by 1024 by the collector).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free RAM of the FireBrick appliance in bytes (fbFreeMem, reported in KiB and multiplied by 1024 by the collector).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used RAM of the FireBrick appliance in bytes, derived as total minus free.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the FireBrick appliance, derived as (total-free)/total. Sustained high usage may indicate memory pressure or leaks.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
